title: Sephiria Artifacts & Tablets — Inventory Grid Tips
description: Sephiria Artifact and Tablet guide: Side Bag rules, adjacency, and why tablet geometry beats raw rarity.
meta: Supports artifact / tablet searches; pairs with builds pages.
body:
Artifacts and Tablets are the mid-run puzzle. Tablets buff geometry (lines, crosses, columns). An Artifact outside an active pattern wastes space.

  • Side Bag storage disables effects—use it as a bench, not a secret second board.
  • Adjacency / edge / “no neighbors” constraints force full reshuffles after bosses.
  • Mystic Pot can convert leftover Artifacts (same rarity, or feed two to climb a rarity)—handy for awkward drops.

Related Sephiria guides

  • Sephiria builds — how Artifacts pair into finished archetypes
  • Weapons & upgrades — upgrade offers change what your Artifacts amplify
  • Destiny Inscription tree — the permanent tree you spend sapphires on

Bond artifacts: the ones that pay for two tags at once

A Bond artifact only switches on when the build already carries both of its tags. That makes them the cheapest way to convert a half-finished plan into a real one — and the fastest way to waste a slot if the second tag never arrives. The list below is the bond set recorded by the community artifact index; treat the pairings as the durable part and any per-level numbers as a snapshot.

Bond artifactNeeds both tagsWhat it is for
Scale of ConflictEmber + GlacierThe fire-and-ice bridge: one slot that keeps a split elemental board alive
Ruby BroochEmber + Storm CloudFire plus attack speed, for builds that want burn ticking faster
Rock ElephantGuardian + Wind SongDefence that still moves — pairs a defensive tag with the speed tag
Shield BagGuardian + AcademyTurns stacked defence into flat elemental damage
Tuning ForkAcademy + SturdySupport-side bond; only worth it once both tags already exist
Icebound TejasEmber + GlacierThe second fire-and-ice bond: two options, same tag pair
Thunderfrost ButterflyStorm Cloud + GlacierLightning plus cold, for freeze-and-zap boards
Droplet of PlitviceIce Armament + LakeWeapon-side ice bond, not an inventory-only effect
Tactical ManualCompanion + PrecisionCompanion damage routed through crit
Shimmering EyeShadow + PrecisionShadow crit bond for burst routes

Source: community artifact index (sephiriaguide.com), checked 9 November 2026. Tag pairings are the part worth relying on; the index is player-maintained, not official, and per-level values move between patches. Two bonds can share the same tag pair (Ember + Glacier has Scale of Conflict and Icebound Tejas), so the choice is about the secondary effect, not the tags.

How to use this page

  • Before a boss: count how many of your slots are bond artifacts whose second tag you do not have yet. Each one is dead weight.
  • When the shop offers a bond: check whether the missing tag is one you can still get from the current tablet layout. If not, skip it.
  • After a reshuffle: adjacency constraints change which slots are live, so re-check bonds before buying another artifact rather than after.
